gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a classic serif whose open-ended curves and larger-than-usual x-height give its words a generous, editorial presence. JetBrains Mono excels at crisp, fixed-width order; Kadwa at flowing text.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-lisu-bosa: Fixed-width, code-style letters give JetBrains Mono a smooth, drawn-wire feel. Lisu Bosa, a serif whose large, sturdy words carry a lightly shaded texture, sits beneath that smooth wire line.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-marcellus-sc: Uniform strokes meet cast-iron stature: JetBrains Mono never swells or thins, while Marcellus SC adds gentle modulation. And the sharpest thing here is that gap, one line unvarying, the other moderately shaded.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-montagu-slab: Neon-glass tubing meets a sturdy serif: JetBrains Mono draws loosely strung, fixed-width letters in one smooth tube-like line. Montagu Slab sits in the middle, between monoline and hairline, so the text beneath feels grounded.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is a serif with big, visible entrances into every curved letter. Its lowercase fills most of the letter height, so long runs of text feel sturdy beside the marker-like line of JetBrains Mono.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-ovo: JetBrains Mono keeps its joins and strokes uniform, fixed-width letters strung loosely like code. Ovo, a serif with a tall middle band and modest stroke modulation, would read steadily and authoritatively over pages.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-piazzolla: Bent-wire constancy up top: JetBrains Mono holds every stroke steady while Piazzolla, a classic serif, keeps its lowercase near capital height. And that e opens like a pried clasp, giving the code-style heading a friendlier partner.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-pridi: Pridi, a classic serif, stands its small letters almost capital-tall and leaves generous space where curves meet stems. But JetBrains Mono, drawn like steel cable without any swelling or thinning, feels mechanical beside it.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads large and spacious, its counters spilling open beside stubby ascenders and descenders. Scope One supplies the warmth, while JetBrains Mono, with no pinched joins or swelling bowls, supplies the machine-straight discipline.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-slabo-13px: Zero stroke contrast defines JetBrains Mono, every fixed-width character strung loosely like terminal code. And Slabo 13px, a classic serif with large open counters in its rounded letters, gives it a bookish counterweight.
